_comment: Default fp status registry (fp's built-in statuses). Copy + edit per project to mirror .fp/extensions/workflow.ts. Order = display + sort order. role: open=active work, done=terminal complete, rejected=terminal won't-do (both done+rejected satisfy a dependency); any other role (e.g. deferred) is neither open nor satisfying. color: a semantic name (neutral/grey/blue/indigo/purple/teal/mint/green/amber/orange/red) or a raw #hex / var(--x).
_stack_comment: stack = bottom-to-top band order in the Trends chart (0 = the base). Optional: a registry without it falls back to terminal states at the base in registry order, then open statuses most-advanced-first. The order below is NOT that fallback — it is the fallback with in-progress and selected swapped, because the fallback puts in-progress (ochre) directly above rejected (orange): OKLab dE 1.4 under deutan and 9.0 even for normal vision, i.e. two touching bands nobody can separate. Swapping the one pair clears every adjacent pair to dE >= 12.9 in BOTH light and dark. Re-validate with the dataviz palette validator if you recolour these.
